Orange-red hair and wolf ears of the same colour, the ear tips black. Amber eyes. A red neckerchief at her throat that reaches a corner before she does. A keen nose that can tell rust from a smithy from rust soaked all winter in rain. A frank, quick, lively air.
build: Lean and quick: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: orange red and black, amber, grey-green, a red neckerchief
casual: Her scout's gear: a grey-green short coat with the cuffs tied tight, dark trousers, soft felt-soled boots, the red neckerchief, a short knife and a water flask at her belt; a mountain-copper guild seal on a cord. She sniffs the wind, an ear turned, a sharp look.
private: In the outer ring on a free day: a loose cream shirt, a brown vest, trousers, the red neckerchief. She holds a skewer of roasted meat. A cheerful grin.
battle: Scouting ahead of the wagon: the coat buttoned, leather bracers. She holds the short knife low and ready, the ears pricked, a sharp look.
formal: At the settlement counter: a clean grey-green coat, the neckerchief neatly tied. She stands very upright, a proud look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber eyes narrowed and the nose wrinkled at a sour smell of rust. Cold windy light of a mountain road from one side. Foreground blur: a fluttering red neckerchief, a rusty bent nail and drifting snow. She wears the grey-green short coat.

name: 珊希娅
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_二_共约的年月.md:2311
who: Sansia, a wood elf of the forest's edge with no family name, who appraises old things brought up from the dungeon at the echo market of the outer ring, about four hundred and ten and looking about thirty: tall and slender, with long pointed ears, the tip of the left one missing a piece. Moss-green hair in one long braid. Pale cyan eyes. An old coin purse at her waist holding one coin from every age, the oldest carved with three rivers. A languid, unhurried air: coins do not grow old, so why hurry?
build: Tall and slender: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: moss green and pale cyan, faded brown, old silver and copper
casual: Her appraiser's clothes: a long faded brown travelling coat over a moss-green tunic, dark leggings and soft boots; the old coin purse at her waist; a small lens on a cord. She holds an old coin up between two fingers, an amused look.
private: At her stall in the echo market: a loose oatmeal linen shirt, a long green skirt, the braid over one shoulder. She lays a row of old coins across her palm. A peaceful look.
battle: Guarding the wagon: a leather jerkin, a bracer on the bow arm, a quiver at her hip. She holds a longbow with an arrow nocked, low and ready, a calm look.
formal: At a council of the forest-edge market: a long green robe embroidered with small leaves, the braid neat. She stands very upright with the hands folded, a serene look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale cyan eyes smiling at an old coin carved with three rivers held up near her face. Warm firelight in a ruined watchtower from one side. Foreground blur: a row of old coins laid out by a fire and falling snowflakes. She wears the faded brown travelling coat.

name: 西拉斯·雨檐
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_二_共约的年月.md:2313
who: Silas, a tiefling priest of the White Candle who grew up sheltering from the rain under the eaves of the Seven's little chapel in the outer ring and named himself for it, forty-six and looking just over thirty: tall and lean. Silver-white hair. Wine-red eyes. Pale cyan markings on the side of his neck. A pair of small dark horns sweeping back. He carries a white-ash staff with no blade; he says he carries no edge. A quiet, patient, watchful air: he will sit outside a door all night so that whoever is inside is not alone.
build: Tall and lean.
palette: silver white and wine red, candle white, pale cyan, ash wood
casual: His White Candle priest's dress: a long grey-white robe with the hem tucked into the belt for travel, a plain white mantle, soft boots; a small white candle-shaped badge at the chest; a mountain-copper guild seal on a cord. He holds the bladeless white-ash staff, a calm look.
private: Under the chapel eaves on a rainy evening: a loose grey wool robe, a wool shawl. He holds a lantern up, waiting for someone to come back. A gentle look.
battle: On the escort road: the robe belted over a padded jerkin, a hooded cloak. He holds the white-ash staff across his body; he carries no blade.
formal: At a White Candle service: a long white robe to the floor, a silver-grey stole. He stands very upright holding a lit white candle, a serene look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the wine-red eyes calm, a lantern held up beside his face at night. Warm lantern light from one side, cold dark beyond. Foreground blur: the canvas wall of a tent, a white-ash staff and drifting rain. He wears the grey-white robe and the white mantle.

name: 芒戈·符文
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_二_共约的年月.md:2326
who: Mungo, a dwarf of the Rune line from the forge city, once a carver of runes over its doors, who now guides in the dungeon and carves one word on the stone at every door and landing so those behind can find the way, about a hundred and fifty: short, broad and sturdy. A grey-white beard in three braids, each tipped with a small copper plate carved with runes, which he tucks into his collar before going down. Thick eyebrows over small eyes; when he laughs his brows move first. A short-handled axe with words carved along its back. A gruff, scolding, big-hearted air; he stands guarantor for the children he scolds.
face: FACE, as in the references: an older dwarf man's face, broad and weathered: small bright eyes under very thick grey brows; deep laugh lines; a grey-white beard in three braids tipped with copper plates; a gruff, scolding mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: Short, broad and sturdy.
palette: grey white and copper, oiled leather brown, iron grey, rune bronze
casual: His guide's gear: the guild's old hardened-leather armour with a small bronze plate on the left shoulder engraved with a balance scale, over a dark wool shirt, dark trousers and heavy boots; the short-handled axe at his belt; a small carving chisel; a mountain-copper guild seal on a cord. He scowls with his arms folded, the brows twitching toward a laugh.
private: At the shaft mouth: a thick wool shirt, a wool cap. He holds out both arms as if to catch someone sliding down a chain. A gruff, fond look.
battle: On a landing of the long stair: the leather armour buckled, leather bracers, the beard plates tucked into the collar. He holds the short-handled axe in both hands, a fierce look.
formal: On the guild's opening day: a clean dark wool coat with bronze buttons, the beard braids freshly tied. He stands very upright with the hands at his sides, a proud look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the small eyes fierce under thick brows, the axe raised beside his face. Cold grey false-dawn light from below on one side. Foreground blur: a rune carved into a stone step, copper beard plates and drifting dust. He wears the old guild leather armour.

name: 朗尼·棚尾
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_二_共约的年月.md:2328
who: Ronnie, a human young man from the reed-shed slums of the imperial capital, nephew of the camp cook Nadine, raised in the guild kitchen since he was eight, eighteen: tall and gangly, growing so fast that his trousers are always a little short. Messy straw-coloured hair. Blue eyes like all his family. A band of freckles across the nose. A slow-spoken, strong, tongue-tied air; he carries the food and rope for his party, and since the stair he goes down with his hands empty.
build: Tall and gangly, still growing, strong in the arms.
palette: straw yellow and blue, brown canvas, rope brown, kitchen white
casual: His carrier's gear: a brown canvas jacket a size too small, a pale shirt, trousers short at the ankle, sturdy boots; a coil of rope and a sack of food on his back; a mountain-copper guild seal on a cord. His hands hang empty at his sides, a shy, earnest look.
private: In the guild kitchen: a loose white shirt, an apron, trousers. He holds a big pot of soup in both arms. A shy smile.
battle: On a landing of the long stair: the jacket buttoned over a leather vest, leather gloves, a bandage on one leg, the rope across his body, a knife left in its sheath. His hands are empty and open.
battle_pose: 3) the descent outfit: tense and steady, the feet planted, an earnest, frightened expression, both hands held open and empty at his sides; a knife stays sheathed at his belt and he does not draw it.
formal: On Ceasefire Day: a clean shirt, a borrowed dark coat too short in the sleeves, the hair combed down. He stands very upright with the hands at his sides, a solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue eyes wet, looking down at his own open, empty hands held up near his face. Cold grey light from below on one side. Foreground blur: a dropped knife, stone steps and drifting dust. He wears the too-small brown canvas jacket.

name: 绮露·落栗
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_二_共约的年月.md:2330
who: Kiru, a fox-eared beastfolk woman of the Fallen Chestnut family, who sell roasted chestnuts at the foot of the second wall, a runner of the party called Undying Noon, nineteen: slim and light. Orange-red hair the same colour as her fox ears; a fluffy fox tail with a white tip. Golden-green eyes with slit pupils. Few words and sharp ears; she was the first to hear the things below turn back. A shy, steady, tender air; she did not cry until it was over.
build: Slim and light: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: orange red and white, golden green, chestnut brown, a little cream
casual: Her runner's clothes: a chestnut-brown wool short coat over a cream shirt, dark trousers and soft boots, a small bag of roasted chestnuts at her belt; a mountain-copper guild seal on a cord. Her ears are turned toward a sound, a quiet, alert look.
private: At the foot of the second wall in winter: a thick wool scarf, a long skirt, an apron. She holds a paper cone of hot roasted chestnuts. A shy smile.
battle: On a landing of the long stair: the coat buttoned, leather bracers, a rope across her body. One arm is held out to support a hurt friend; she carries only a small knife and does not fight.
battle_pose: 3) the runner's outfit: tense and alert, the feet planted, a steady expression, one arm held out as if supporting a hurt friend, the ears turned back to listen; she carries only a small knife and does not fight.
formal: On Ceasefire Day: a clean chestnut-brown dress with a cream collar, the tail brushed. She stands very upright with the hands folded, a quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the golden-green slit-pupilled eyes listening into the dark below, the fox ears pricked. Cold darkness with a faint warm glow from above on one side. Foreground blur: stone steps, a bandaged arm over her shoulder and drifting dust. She wears the chestnut-brown short coat.
